title: CHECKING DIMENSIONS
summary: Body (bolt/weld) checking dimensions, all models, continued: cross-sections of the windshield frame upper (header), the lock pillar reinforcement (B-pillar / door lock pillar) with its brace and the folding top hinge support, and the front roof center support and roof bow (the T-top center bar area above the windshield), measured from the body grid lines. No parts or fasteners are listed.
